quest_explore.title: Beyond Brightvale
quest_explore.desc: Elder Bram urged you to explore the island and find the treasures of the fallen star. He mentioned a dark cave to the west, a hill of braziers to the north-east and a pillar in the south-eastern lake.

quest_slime.title: Slime Trouble
quest_slime.desc: Defeat a slime for Guard Tomas at the east gate, then report back to him.

quest_mochi.title: Lost Kitten
quest_mochi.desc: Find Lina's orange kitten Mochi somewhere near the big hill to the north-east, then tell Lina.
